@StormLiangMS @wangxin @yxieca A user wants to merge changes to the conditional mark files into `202605`. Please review.

Hi @StormLiangMS — a quick update on the disposition here.

I first tried simply closing the tracking issue https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/25549, but the repo guard workflow (github-actions) auto-reopened it within a minute:

> This issue is referenced by conditional mark entries and cannot be closed manually. To close it, remove all references to this issue from conditional mark files/tests across all supported releases, then close the issue again.

So closing the issue alone is no longer sufficient — the `conditional_mark` reference has to be removed first. #25549 is referenced only on 202605 (this branch), in the single `test_bgp_prefix_tc1_suite` xfail entry, so this PR is exactly what clears it.

On the passing side: the underlying failure was a read-side libyang3 regression (emptied pattern-constrained leaf-lists rejected during GCU validation), fixed by https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/28248 and backported to 202605 in https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/28308. The latest 202605 nightly runs show `test_bgp_prefix_tc1_suite` passing on images that include the fix — both the empty-community and non-empty-community patches apply successfully, and the invalid-prefix negative cases are correctly rejected.

Could you help review/merge this so we can then close #25549?

Hi @StormLiangMS, I think there are two separate things getting conflated here, so let me split them out.

**1. The linked run is a 202605 nightly, but this PR targets master.** The xfail entry is gated on a *different* issue on each branch:
- **master** (this PR) → [sonic-buildimage #27818](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/27818) — the GCU **write-side** bug ("emptying a leaf-list writes `""` to CONFIG_DB").
- **202605** → [sonic-mgmt #25549](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/25549) — the test-tracking issue.

So a 202605 testplan doesn't reflect what this master change does.

**2. The test is not actually failing — including in the run you linked.** Reading the debug log of that plan, every GCU operation behaves as the test expects:
- the empty-patch apply (`echo "[]" | config apply-patch`) — the original libyang3 regression — returns **rc 0** ("Patch applied successfully");
- the add/replace/remove/rollback all succeed (rc 0);
- all four invalid-prefix patches are correctly rejected (rc 2), which is what `expect_op_failure` wants;
- there is no traceback / `AssertionError` / `XFAILURES` section anywhere.

The `xfail_skipped` you're seeing is the issue-gated xfail mark being absorbed by the reporting (the run resolves the mark live against the GitHub issue state and applies it while the issue is open), not a real failure. Corroboration: on 202511, where this xfail was already removed, the identical test records clean `success`.

**3. Why this master PR is still needed.** The read-side validation this test exercises is fixed on master ([sonic-buildimage #28248](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/28248), merged 2026-07-09). The remaining open issue #27818 is a *write-side* code path that this test doesn't assert on, so it isn't a valid reason to keep the test xfailed — and since #27818 can't be closed yet (write-side fix pending), the mark won't auto-clear via issue closure. Removing the stale entry here is the correct action, not a mask over a real failure.
